content: I need a box, that is on the upside open. The outer dimensions are 220 x 300 x 160mm. The wall thickness should be 8mm and the bottom thickness 12mm | Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once

function_call.arguments: "{\"PythonCode\":\"# Calculate inner dimensions of the box\\nouter_length = 220\\nouter_width = 300\\nouter_height = 160\\nwall_thickness = 8\\nbottom_thickness = 12\\n\\ninner_length = outer_length - 2 * wall_thickness\\ninner_width = outer_width - 2 * wall_thickness\\ninner_height = outer_height - bottom_thickness\\n\\n# Base points for the outer and inner boxes\\nouter_x = 0\\nouter_y = 0\\nouter_z = 0\\n\\ninner_x = wall_thickness\\ninner_y = wall_thickness\\ninner_z = bottom_thickness\\n\\n# Print the calculated values\\nprint(f\\\"Outer dimensions: {outer_length} x {outer_width} x {outer_height} mm\\\")\\nprint(f\\\"Inner dimensions: {inner_length} x {inner_width} x {inner_height} mm\\\")\\nprint(f\\\"Outer base point: ({outer_x}, {outer_y}, {outer_z}) mm\\\")\\nprint(f\\\"Inner base point: ({inner_x}, {inner_y}, {inner_z}) mm\\\")\"}"

{"PythonCode":"# Calculate inner dimensions of the box
outer_length = 220
outer_width = 300
outer_height = 160
wall_thickness = 8
bottom_thickness = 12

inner_length = outer_length - 2 * wall_thickness
inner_width = outer_width - 2 * wall_thickness
inner_height = outer_height - bottom_thickness

# Base points for the outer and inner boxes
outer_x = 0
outer_y = 0
outer_z = 0

inner_x = wall_thickness
inner_y = wall_thickness
inner_z = bottom_thickness

# Print the calculated values
print(f"Outer dimensions: {outer_length} x {outer_width} x {outer_height} mm")
print(f"Inner dimensions: {inner_length} x {inner_width} x {inner_height} mm")
print(f"Outer base point: ({outer_x}, {outer_y}, {outer_z}) mm")
print(f"Inner base point: ({inner_x}, {inner_y}, {inner_z}) mm")"}
